snippet.title: Su From So - Kannada OFFICIAL TRAILER | JP Thuminad | Shaneel Gautham | Lighter Buddha Films
snippet.description:
In a peaceful village full of joy, laughter, and vibrant life, everything seems perfect—until one day, the devil arrives. What follows is a hilarious chain of events that flips the entire village upside down!

SU is here… and SO is all the madness💥 
#SuFromSoTrailer is now OUT. 

#SuFromSo — In Cinemas 25th July, 2025
